summary.text: Ann Meyer is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 8 who has served in the Iowa House since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nurse.

paragraphs.text: Ann Meyer was born in Redford, Michigan, and earned a B.S. in nursing from the University of Detroit Mercy.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse, and she has served on health care advisory boards and the Iowa Central Community College Simulation Center Advisory Board.
Meyer defeated Gary Waechter in the June 5, 2018 Republican primary for Iowa House District 9 and Democrat Megan Srinivas in the November 6, 2018 general election.
She won re-election in District 9 in 2020 over Charles Clayton, and in the redrawn District 8 in 2022 and 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows her assigned to the House Appropriations, House Human Resources and House Transportation committees and as vice chair of the Health Policy Oversight Committee.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Kristofer Williams in the general election.
